wiki.title: Amanda Mays Bledsoe
wiki.extract: Amanda Mays Bledsoe (born February 15, 1978) is an American politician from Kentucky. She is a member of the Republican Party and has represented District 12 in the Kentucky Senate since January 1, 2023. She was a member of the Lexington-Fayette Urban County Council from the 10th district from 2015 to 2023.
